plan.notes: Source: Agnes Scott College 2025-2026 Undergraduate Academic Catalog (official PDF), English Literature major requirements: ENG-280, ENG-480; two 200-level + four 300-level literature courses; at least two pre-1800 and two post-1800; 40 cr total. Course titles hand-transcribed 2026-09-30; pre/post-1800 classifications per catalog topic tags. Semester sequence assembled from prerequisites (ENG-280 requires a 200-level lit course first; ENG-480 requires senior English Literature major standing). Advisor should confirm. Gen ed = SUMMIT 34 cr + 12 cr language + electives to 128.
